scope: Read-only exact original REL003 policy refusal eligibility and smallest protected-field attempt review artifact/local fixture-trust window. No product/test/shared document changes, new case execution, owner question or wholeRM601/603 qualification.

frozen_definition.title: todo ownership cannot be reassigned through create, patch, or ordinary mutation

accepted_case_criterion.reason: The exact original case is kind policy. It requires releaseEquivalentSuccess=false, disposition=requires_human_decision and policyRule=Todo.fields.owner_id. It has no positive grant/valid protected issuer/release success, complete canonical behavior system, DB execution or healthy transport prerequisite. A genuinely compiler-derived exact attempted-field denial artifact and independent actual collector/decoder evidence can qualify this refusal; whole canonical/protected release requirements remain open independently.
accepted_case_criterion.not_currently_qualified: Current scaffold native update refusal and unrelated checked field-policy projection do not supply this exact disposition/subject. No case promotion in this audit.

current_grounding.fact: Todo.owner_id is a direct TodoRole.owner binding and immutable. Compiler marks such fields update_forbidden and emits TYPE_FIELD_UPDATE_FORBIDDEN. Entity update permission or an approval cannot override write ownership; a named transfer needs deliberate separate policy/authority/lifecycle semantics, and initial implementation may refuse it entirely.

Existing v5 ApprovalSubject requires both before/after supplied projects to have no frontend errors. It emits local_inspection_non_releasable/release_authority=false and generic fact-change decisions; it does not emit requires_human_decision for the actual invalid ownership mutation.

Field source contracts retain exact declaration tokens/type/reference and operation mappings; actor links retain checked nominal identity/scope/current-row requirements but are static may-call conditions. These helpers can bind exact protected baseline field and attempted write provenance; they do not establish feasible runtime owner transfer or reviewer authority.

Current harness injects a real ordinary update attempt and separately adds a valid owner field policy for approval projection. It explicitly records semanticDisposition=null and unrelated projection scope. Reusing projectionApproval or hardcoded harness labels would not establish original REL003.

smallest_implementation_window.step3: Emit requested-change disposition requires_human_decision and releaseEquivalentSuccess=false with release_authority=false for this supported exact protected-field request. Other type/syntax errors must not be promoted to equivalent protected-policy review success.
smallest_implementation_window.step4: Provide a machine-readable/local non-graphical path and capture the actual checked baseline plus diagnosed attempt artifact in the golden collector. Validate exact request/field/baseline/diagnostic/canonical bytes; explicitly refuse using a separate benign field-policy projection or ordinary repository assertion as substitute. Two backend ledger records may point to the same genuinely observed compiler-policy artifact with an honest static evidence classification; do not pretend that an unexecuted compiler-refused write ran on either database.
smallest_implementation_window.step5: If adding a narrow local fixture trust adapter, accept authenticated test issuer context out of band and bind exact subject/decision/policy/graph/compiler/schema/expiry/authority. Distinguish fixture-validation results from protected release authority. Missing/foreign/self-issued/stale/replayed/forged ordinary JSON stays refused. Even a trusted local positive fixture must remain non-releasable; no source/env/file switch can bootstrap actual issuer or override immutable ownership.

required_scoped_observables: Actual CLI/compiler invocation of original attempted owner reassignment yields exact subject/path and requires_human_decision with no release-equivalent success. Baseline source is checked fresh; original action remains compile-refused and unexecuted.

Change protected entity/field, intent to another row/owner, target assignment/value provenance, diagnostic span/source, baseline policy/semantic graph, compiler/schema or attempt source; full decoder must reject stale/foreign or coherently rehashed unrelated subject/export. Valid renamed protected entity/field derives its own identity without hardcoded golden names.

Create/client-owner input, patch, ordinary update, alias/local/base-type copy cannot evade protected target-field ownership. Preserve existing checked source success for allowed title/status changes and actual forbidden-owner controls; no runtime transfer API added.

The field-policy projection alone, untouched source with changed human narrative, arbitrary type error, missing protected target, incomplete attempt or generic non-releasable artifact cannot satisfy exact REL003.

Test-only trust validation refuses local approval.json/env assertions, wrong subject/decision/authority/self issuer, stale/revoked/expired or consumed fixture token. Exact positive fixture if present only validates fixture mechanics and still cannot release.

Independent immutable consequential artifact/diagnostic/policy review and fresh source-bound collector negative mutations before case qualification. Complete RM601 facts/wholeRM603/AP matrix/RM604 protected CI stay separately unclosed.

owner_dependency.why: The frozen case requests a refusal artifact, not actual ownership transfer permission. Preserve accepted POLICY-D19/D36 and transfer constraints. Routine narrow derivation/fixture validation is eligible within authorized implementation; human transfer design/real protected authority would be a different scope and is not selected here.
